observed.assets_smb:
[Assets]
	comment = Assets share directory
	hide unreadable = Yes
	path = /volume1/Assets
	skip smb perm = Yes
	use sendfile = Yes
	valid users = 123 [REDACTED-ACCOUNT-ID] @admin @group_assets
	vfs objects = catia fruit full_audit recycle streams_xattr ug_xattr_filter
	write list = 123 [REDACTED-ACCOUNT-ID] @admin @group_assets
	recycle:exclude_dir    = #recycle
	recycle:maxsize        = 0
	recycle:minsize        = 0
	recycle:directory_mode = 0777
	recycle:versions       = Yes
	recycle:keeptree       = Yes
	recycle:repository     = #recycle
